data.title: 德尔塔 · 艳阳礁石上的巨鱼战利品
data.description: 碧海蓝天的阳光珊瑚礁石上，海浪飞溅。身穿豹纹泳装的德尔塔高高举起刚徒手抓到的大鱼，浑身水珠闪闪发光，仰天欢呼。
data.location: sun-drenched ocean coral reef with crashing turquoise sea waves
data.action: standing proudly atop a wet sea rock, lifting a massive caught fish high overhead with both hands, shouting in victory with gleaming wet skin
data.lighting: 热带烈阳直射与水面耀斑
data.promptProse: Delta stands triumphant atop a sunlit ocean reef holding an enormous freshly caught fish overhead, laughing jubilantly as sea spray splashes around her.
data.animaCaption: Bright tropical sunlight glistens on her wet shoulders as she hoists her marine catch.
